_comment: Shared settings file: version-controlled defaults used by frontend and backend. See docs/CONFIG-REFERENCE.md section 14.
_candidates: Max images per lookup (currently 20 in RevenueNswSummaryMapper.MAX_IMAGES)
Max detail fields per lookup (currently 40 in RevenueNswSummaryMapper.MAX_DETAILS)
Max cache entries for evidence lookups (currently 100 in ScraperEvidenceLookupAdapter.MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES)
Evidence scraper cache TTL (currently 120s, already configurable via CEVOC_SCRAPER_EVIDENCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS)
Banner OCR timeout (currently 30s, already configurable via CEVOC_BANNER_OCR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
Notice number length (currently 10 digits, validated in lookupValidation.js)
Registration max length (currently 8 chars, validated in lookupValidation.js)
